{
  "name": "dl",
  "displayName": "Daily Learning",
  "version": "0.12.2",
  "description": "Daily learning in Claude Code: Chitas (Chumash with Rashi, Tehillim, Tanya), Rambam, Hayom Yom and Daf Yomi (with Rashi) on one line above the prompt, and the full Hebrew text in a sidebar.",
  "author": {
    "name": "Shersheial",
    "url": "https://github.com/sharshi"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/sharshi/daily-learning-plugin",
  "repository": "https://github.com/sharshi/daily-learning-plugin",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "daily-learning",
    "chitas",
    "torah",
    "rambam",
    "tanya",
    "tehillim",
    "daf-yomi",
    "talmud",
    "hebrew",
    "mod"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "hebrew_font": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Hebrew font",
      "description": "The font the sidebar's Hebrew is drawn in: Frank Ruhl (the default) or Shlomo, both bundled, with nikkud. The Desktop app draws with it directly; for Ghostty it's installed for your user and Ghostty's Hebrew is mapped to it. System leaves every font alone.",
      "options": [
        "Frank Ruhl",
        "Shlomo",
        "System"
      ],
      "default": "Frank Ruhl"
    },
    "english": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "English",
      "description": "Show the English translation: Off, Staggered (under each paragraph) or Side by side (English left, Hebrew right).",
      "options": [
        "Off",
        "Staggered",
        "Side by side"
      ],
      "default": "Off"
    },
    "nikkud": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Nikkud",
      "description": "Show the Hebrew with vowels.",
      "default": true
    },
    "rashi": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Rashi",
      "description": "Show Rashi under each verse (Chumash) or passage (Daf Yomi).",
      "default": true
    },
    "text_size": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Text size",
      "description": "The sidebar's text size in the Desktop app (a terminal uses its own).",
      "options": [
        "Small",
        "Medium",
        "Large"
      ],
      "default": "Medium"
    },
    "wait_suggest": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "While Claude works",
      "description": "When a turn runs long, suggest learning on the line above the prompt: after 45 seconds, after 2 minutes, or off. At most once every 30 minutes.",
      "options": [
        "After 45 seconds",
        "After 2 minutes",
        "Off"
      ],
      "default": "After 45 seconds"
    }
  }
}
